source.title: Accelerating high-throughput catalyst screening by direct generation of equilibrium adsorption structures
source.locator: Supplementary Information, Supplementary Table 2, PDF page 14
source.edition: Publisher Article in Press and accompanying SI

kind: Review reconstruction of reported workflow times; no model execution or timing benchmark rerun
sample: The same randomly selected subset of 1000 structures from the Catalysis-Hub test set
SP_definition: Single-point energy evaluation at the prepared geometry

plot.panels: Separate linear time axes; limits differ between the UMA and DFT-SP panels
plot.reason_success_not_pooled: UMA and DFT-SP panels use different reference energies, so their success rates are not a common accuracy ranking.

panels.title_ko: A  UMA 에너지로 평가하는 선별 흐름
panels.reference: UMA-OC20 SP energy of the DFT-relaxed structure

rows.geometry_operation: Full UMA-OC20 relaxation, including its final UMA energy
rows.energy_evaluation: UMA-OC20 energy included in relaxation time

panels.title_ko: B  DFT 단일점 에너지를 더한 구조 품질 확인
panels.reference: DFT-SP energy of the DFT-relaxed structure

success_definition: |E_method - E_ref| < 0.1 eV; energy MAE uses the same panel-specific reference
relaxation_conditions: All MLIP relaxations used ASE LBFGS, fmax=0.05 eV/Angstrom, maximum 200 optimization steps
interpretation_boundary: The lower two rows compare DBCata generation + DFT-SP with UMA-OC20 relaxation + DFT-SP. They are not a timing comparison against direct DFT geometry relaxation. DFT-SP rows are high-fidelity structural-quality validation rather than the intended rapid-screening workflow.
integrated_energy_note: The full UMA relaxation row has no separately reported SP time; null does not mean no energy evaluation. Its 8.0996 s includes the resulting UMA energy.
omitted_Table2_rows: DBCata(100), MACE-OMAT and ORB-v3 variants are not drawn; this is a selected four-row comparison, not all Table 2 workflows.
